matrix_meta.parac_na_reason: ParAC graph mode grounds a singular Laplacian by generating a zero-sum RHS for it; this matrix is a published full-rank operator, which has no null space to ground and goes through ParAC's physics path instead

provenance.note: ParAC at upstream 44ef39d + benchmarks/patches/parac/0001 (thread-count gate + configurable tolerance; no numerics touched). kind=graph -> GRAPH mode on the PURE L per connected component, ParAC's own zero-sum RHS; kind=operator -> PHYSICS mode on the PUBLISHED operator augmented ParAC's own way (permute, then append the ground row/column the trim removes). Input prepared by ParAC's OWN cpu_implementation/write_graph.jl (graph_produce / physics_produce, method 'amd'), not by a reimplementation. Tolerance calibrated from a probe run so ParAC's own printed relative residual lands under 1e-8. AMD-reordered, MKL serial, 16 cores
